judgments.rationale: The source explicitly states that the designated official 'shall deem' any person qualified unless an exception applies. Adding 'deem' as the action and action_quote accurately captures the operative verb governed by the modality 'shall' and remedies an empty field in the baseline claim without introducing errors.

The statutory disqualifications in paragraphs (1) through (5) are disjunctive, joined by 'or' between (4) and (5). A person is disqualified if any single condition applies. The proposed summary alters this to require that 'all of the following are true' and joins them with 'and', which materially alters the legal standard by requiring an individual to meet every disqualification concurrently before being excluded.
